case_title: MAOHU @ MADHURANATHA & ANR. v. STATE OF KARNATAKA
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.27
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 364, 302, 201 read with Section 34 IPC and sentenced to death under Section 302 r/w 34 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, three individuals, were involved in an incident where the son of a witness was murdered, robbed, and his body was disposed of in a river. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including witness statements, recovery of stolen property, and forensic reports. The deceased was last seen with the accused before his death. The accused were identified through witness accounts and forensic evidence, including DNA and post-mortem reports. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 364, 302, and 201 of the IPC, along with Section 34, and sentenced them to death. The High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence.
